threads.subject: UT Austin Student & PGN Member Interested in Banking @ Goldman Sachs in London

messages.subject: UT Austin Student & PGN Member Interested in Banking @ Goldman Sachs in London
messages.body:
Hello Victoria,

I hope you are doing well. I am a Fall PC ‘22 PGN member studying Business and Economics, and I'm pursuing a career in Investment Banking. I'd love to talk to you to learn more about your experience at Goldman in London. I am particularly interested in learning about your experience, as I spent my past summer studying at the London School of Economics.

If you have any free time in the next week, it would be great to set up a quick phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan
